estonia.title: President Alar Karis will not run for second presidential term
estonia.description: President Alar Karis said in his Victory Day parade on Tuesday that he will not stand as a candidate at this autumn's election, putting an end to months of speculation.

estonia.title: Gallery: Estonia's Victory Day marked with annual parade in Rapla
estonia.description: The Estonian Defense League held its annual parade to mark Victory Day on Tuesday (June 23).

estonia.title: Police receiving more calls about potential bomb threats
estonia.description: The number of bomb scare-related calls to the police is increasing in Estonia, and checking abandoned items requires considerable resources from the emergency services.

estonia.title: Work progressing on Saatse Boot bypasses in south Estonia
estonia.description: Construction of the new bypass roads around Saatse Boot, a stretch of road running through Russia in south Estonia, is in full swing and on schedule, the Transport Administration has said.

estonia.title: Consumers are buying less alcohol around Midsummer
estonia.description: Sales of strong alcohol are noticeably lower around Midsummer this year, supermarkets say, due to customers' declining purchasing power.

estonia.title: 'Key' to Estonia's first IRIS-T missile defense system unit handed over to Air Force
estonia.description: Estonia's Air Force received its first IRIS-T SLM mobile air defense missile system unit on Monday, which will boost the country's air defense allowing it to engage threats at a greater distance.

estonia.title: Defence Forces want to retain right to check civilians' smart devices
estonia.description: The Estonian Defense Forces want to retain the right to search civilians' phones and smart devices under new legislation drawn up by the Ministry of Justice to reduce the scope of checks.

estonia.title: Estonian universities add programs and change admissions rules
estonia.description: Estonian universities will launch new programs and revise admission criteria for the 2026/2027 academic year, aiming to update curricula and address labor market needs while keeping study places largely unchanged.

estonia.title: Summer expected to be warmer than average, heatwaves not ruled out
estonia.description: Longer-term forecasts indicate that both July and August will be warmer than average in Estonia, Meteorologist Ele Pedassaar said on Monday.

estonia.title: 'Ideal' summer weather forecast for Midsummer's Eve
estonia.description: Midsummer Eve (June 23) will be dry and calm, but rain is forecast on Midsummer Day (June 24), said Meteorologist Ele Pedassaar on Monday.

estonia.title: Neuromarketing helping reveal secret mechanisms behind purchase decisions
estonia.description: A new doctoral dissertation shows that to predict consumers' actual choices, companies need to simultaneously measure a product's ability to attract attention, people's facial expressions and their rational preferences.

estonia.title: Rescue Board struggling with lithium battery fires
estonia.description: Lithium-ion batteries cause dozens of fires in Estonia every year. Extinguishing them is more difficult and time-consuming than putting out conventional fires.

estonia.title: Helsinki is main global gateway for Estonian air passengers
estonia.description: During the summer season, Finnair serves a total of up to 86 flights per week from three Estonian airports, company's Baltic market manager Arunas Skuja said in a Delfi interview.

estonia.title: Viscosa Cultural Factory in Hiiumaa showcases art on 4,000 square meters
estonia.description: It took four years to turn a former fish processing plant on Hiiumaa into Viscosa Cultural Factory, one of Estonia's largest and most distinctive cultural centers.

estonia.title: Attack drone carrying 5 kilograms of explosives found in south Estonia
estonia.description: An attack drone carrying 5 kilograms of explosives was found in south Estonia and authorities said it could be linked to a Ukrainian strike on Russia in early June.

estonia.title: Island ferry traffic for Midsummer down from last year
estonia.description: Fewer people have traveled to Estonia's islands to celebrate Midsummer so far this year, despite additional ferry capacity, TS Laevad said, with both passenger and vehicle numbers slightly below last year's levels.

estonia.title: Züleyxa Izmailova: Reform Party populism will cost Estonia hundreds of millions
estonia.description: The Reform Party's values are shifting. From a once liberal and at least rhetorically progressive party, it is becoming one that increasingly imitates rightwing populism, MP Züleyxa Izmailova writes.

estonia.title: Preparations underway in Estonian prisons for receiving Swedish prisoners
estonia.description: Legislatively, almost everything is in place for bringing Swedish prisoners to Estonia, with only the prison lease agreement still awaiting promulgation by the president. Recruitment of new prison officers for Tartu Prison is currently underway.

estonia.title: Pärnu becomes Estonia's summer capital again
estonia.description: At 11:24 a.m. on Sunday, summer officially began. To mark the occasion, Pärnu once again became Estonia's summer capital, for the 31st time.

estonia.title: Seitsmemägi Hill officially reopened after restoration on 100th anniversary
estonia.description: This year marks the 100th anniversary of Lõunalaager (South Camp) near Petseri, a key summer training site for Estonia's prewar military. Its landmark, Seitsmemägi, has now been restored.

estonia.title: Finland hands Estonian gang members prison sentences
estonia.description: A Finnish court has convicted 27 people in a large-scale drug trafficking case. Several Estonians are among those found guilty, Yle reported.

estonia.title: Lubja intersection traffic and trams return to normal
estonia.description: Regular traffic will resume Monday at the Lubja tänav and Tartu maantee intersection in central Tallinn as the turn from Tartu maantee to Lubja tänav reopens and trams resume normal two-way service.

estonia.title: Police to relax speed camera fine threshold
estonia.description: Police are planning to increase the speed at which drivers begin to receive fines for speeding by 3 kilometers per hour. The impact would be significant as nearly half of all speeding tickets are currently issued for such minor violations.

estonia.title: Ministry discusses raising IVF funded treatment age limit
estonia.description: The Ministry of Social Affairs is planning to amend artificial insemination legislation and is discussing raising the age limit for funded treatments.

estonia.title: Gallery: Van Gogh immersive exhibition opens in Tallinn's Telliskivi
estonia.description: An international immersive exhibition dedicated to the works of Van Gogh opened at Telliskivi Creative City in Tallinn on June 18.

estonia.title: Tallinn Fringe announces first acts for 10th anniversary festival
estonia.description: The Tallinn Fringe Festival turns 10 this year and will celebrate with its traditional month-long performing arts line-up across the capital.

estonia.title: Estonia to become first country to issue ID codes to AI agents
estonia.description: Estonia plans to become the first country in the world to introduce digital identities for AI agents to better regulate the industry, Prime Minister Kristen Michal (Reform) has said.

estonia.title: Salaries too low to fill employment gaps, emergency service agencies say
estonia.description: The Police and Border Guard Board (PPA) and the Rescue Services Agency are facing a staffing gap as the number of new recruits does not match those retiring. The agencies say low salaries are the main problem.

estonia.title: Estonia to change crisis blood donation rules, share stocks with allies
estonia.description: The Estonian Defense Forces will be granted the right to collect blood during crises and share reserves with allies during wartime if supply chains are disrupted under new legislation.

estonia.title: Tallinn to offer €20 million toward private Lasnamäe pool development
estonia.description: Tallinn will offer up to €20 million to a private developer to build a long-planned swim and spa complex in Lasnamäe. Opposition leaders say the city should build it itself.

estonia.title: Tallinn sees 60% rise in bike and scooter traffic in recent years
estonia.description: Light mobility traffic in Tallinn has risen about 60 percent in the past five years, city figures show, though critics question how accurately the data reflects actual use.

estonia.title: Photos: US Marines practice amphibious landing on Estonia's Saaremaa
estonia.description: A U.S. Marine Corps force reconnaissance unit practiced an amphibious landing on Estonia's largest island during the largest naval exercise in the Baltic Sea, BALTOPS 2026.

estonia.title: Estonia's online gambling tax cut fails to lure new operators
estonia.description: Despite expectations of boosting investment and tax revenue, Estonia's online gambling tax cut has failed to attract the hoped-for wave of new operators.

estonia.title: ETV+ warns Estonia's language law changes could cut viewership
estonia.description: ETV+ editor-in-chief Ekaterina Taklaja says new restrictions on dubbing foreign-language content could significantly reduce ERR's Russian-language audience.

estonia.title: Estonian fencer Katrina Lehis claims second European title with épée gold
estonia.description: Estonia's Katrina Lehis took épée gold after a dominant run in France this week, earning her second European title at the European Senior Fencing Championships.

estonia.title: Gallery: Ruins reimagined in EKA student installation in Tartu
estonia.description: What looks like ruins in Tartu's Annelinn is actually a new space for locals to relax, designed and built by architecture students from the Estonian Academy of Arts (EKA).

estonia.title: EKRE's Mart Helme post pulled over disputed use of Singing Revolution anthem
estonia.description: A campaign post featuring EKRE founder Mart Helme was removed from social media after using Alo Mattiisen's 1988 hit "Isamaa ilu hoieldes" unauthorized.

estonia.title: Supreme Court finds Environmental Board's 2020 wolf hunting quota illegal
estonia.description: The Supreme Court has ruled that the Environmental Board's 2020 order authorizing the hunting of wolves was unlawful because the agency failed to take into account the Bern Convention, under which wolves were still subject to strict protection at the time.

estonia.title: Cultural envoy: Estonian performers proudly represent their homeland on every stage
estonia.description: "Soft diplomacy is part of our security — if people know us, they won't abandon us," says Estonia's long-time cultural attaché in Germany, Merit Kopli.

estonia.title: Tõnis Saarts: Estonian voters are choosing greater inequality
estonia.description: Nine months before the next parliamentary elections, it appears that Estonian voters are more willing to accept reduced social security and growing inequality than higher taxes or a substantial overhaul of the current tax system, Tõnis Saarts says.

estonia.title: Two killed in Järva County crash with truck
estonia.description: Two people were killed Friday afternoon when a truck collided with a car at an intersection in Järva County.

estonia.title: Report: Mental health crisis delaying Estonian youths' independence
estonia.description: While shrinking future generations face growing pressure, a new report warns worsening mental health is limiting Estonian youths' independence and participation in society.

estonia.title: Children's camp VAT relief pushed to July, leaving families paying more
estonia.description: A long-awaited VAT exemption for children's camps is finally set to take effect, but not until July, leaving families still paying more for summer camps in June.

estonia.title: Estonia mulls 1 year 'cooling off' period for officials moving to private sector
estonia.description: The Riigikogu Anti-Corruption Select Committee has initiated a bill that would impose a ban of up to one year on senior public officials taking jobs with companies linked to the sectors they previously oversaw.

estonia.title: MoD official: Ukraine able to fend off overwhelming Russian troops with drones
estonia.description: Ukraine's drone units have helped its armed forces fend off attacks by numerically superior Russian troops on the front line, Gert Kaju, head of the defense readiness department at the Ministry of Defense, said.

estonia.title: Estonian camera headed for deep-space mission in 2028
estonia.description: The optical periscope camera OPIC, a scientific instrument bound for Estonia's first deep-space mission, departed Tartu Airport for Spain on Tuesday. The camera will photograph the nucleus of a comet.

estonia.title: Estonia plans €7 million upgrade to centralized health specialist dashboard
estonia.description: Estonia plans to spend up to €7 million overhauling a digital platform that gives healthcare workers a more complete and accessible view of patients' medical info.

estonia.title: Gulf of Riga offshore wind farm transmission line corridor picked
estonia.description: Under the state special plan, the route begins as an undersea cable in the Gulf of Riga and transitions to an overhead power line in Arumetsa before continuing to the Kilingi-Nõmme substation.

estonia.title: A shopping center is rising on top of an ancient cemetery in Järva‑Jaani
estonia.description: Archaeological rescue excavations behind the Järva‑Jaani cemetery wall in central Estonia, where a shopping center expansion is being built, uncovered a cemetery with multiple layers of burials.

estonia.title: Expert: The initiative in the war is beginning to tilt toward Ukraine
estonia.description: Ukraine has gained a psychological advantage with its attacks on Russia over the past week, and although the initiative in the war still lies with Russia for now, it is gradually beginning to shift toward Ukraine, security expert Rainer Saks said. He also predicted a long‑term fuel shortage for Moscow in light of the latest strikes.

estonia.title: Kõlvart: Karis otsustas võimuparteide intriigide tõttu mitte jätkata
estonia.description: Keskerakonna esimees Mihhail Kõlvart leiab, et rahva toetusega president Alar Karis loobus uuesti ametisse kandideerimisest Toompea võimukoalitsiooni intriigide tõttu.

estonia.title: VANA KULD ⟩ Kuulajad valisid oma lemmiku Heldur Karmo laulude seast
estonia.description: Vikerraadio kutsus taasavastama ja reastama sõnameister Heldur Karmo laulusõnu. Menukaks kujunenud hääletusel hindasid kuulajad parimaks sõnad laulule «Unustuse jõel».

estonia.title: VIDEOINTERVJUU ⟩ Silvia pulmakülalised: et see abielu oleks sama pikk nagu see loor!
estonia.description: Silvia Ilvese pulmas Taevaskojas oli külaliste seas palju kuulsusi. Katrin Lust käis peo jooksul neist mõnega vestlemas ja uurimas, mida nad armastust täis sündmusest arvavad ning millised on nende soovid värskele noorpaarile. «Ma pole eales nii suursuguses pulmas käinud,» sõnas armastuse maaletooja Epp Kärsin.

estonia.title: 12-aastane tüdruk rööviti ja võeti pantvangi, eriüksuse saabudes paljastus ootamatu pettus
estonia.description: Lapse kadumine ja inimrööv on iga lapsevanema jaoks suurim ja halvaim õudusunenägu. Just sellisesse põrgusse paisati hiljuti Brasiilias ühe perekonna elu, kui nende 12-aastane tütar kodust jäljetult kadus ning hakkas vanematele saatma ahastama panevaid tekstisõnumeid. Tulemus osutus aga millekski selliseks, mida ei osanud oodata isegi kogenud uurijad.

latvia.title: Kvůli Turkovi jsem k soudu nešel, odmítl Babiš Pavlovu žalobu
latvia.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) zveřejnil své stanovisko ke kompetenční žalobě, kterou v úterý podal prezident Petr Pavel kvůli tomu, že jej vláda neschválila jako člena delegace na červencový summit NATO v turecké Ankaře. Podle Babiše by na sebe ústavní činitelé neměli podávat žaloby a dodal, že sám na prezidenta žalobu nepodal, když Pavel odmítl jmenovat motoristického kandidáta Filipa Turka ministrem.

latvia.title: Kdo může rozhodovat o účasti hlavy státu? Pavel chce, aby to Ústavní soud rozsekl
latvia.description: Obsahem kompetenční žaloby, s níž se prezident Petr Pavel obrátil na Ústavní soud, je jasné určení toho, kdo může rozhodovat o účasti hlavy státu na summitu NATO. Žádá rovněž, aby kabinet prezidentovi takříkajíc „neházel klacky pod nohy“.

latvia.title: Prezident Pavel podal k Ústavním soudu kompetenční žalobu
latvia.description: Ústavní soud v pondělí obdržel kompetenční žalobu prezidenta. Petr Pavel ji podal v souvislosti s rozhodnutím vlády neumožnit mu účast na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Pavel považuje rozhodnutí kabinetu za bezprecedentní a nešťastné. Chce, aby ÚS vyjasnil, zda může vláda o účasti hlavy státu na summitu rozhodovat a zároveň žádá, aby ÚS uložil kabinetu nevytvářet mu překážky ve výkonu funkce prezidenta, a naopak mu poskytoval součinnost.

latvia.title: Prezident podal kompetenční žalobu na vládu kvůli účasti na summitu NATO
latvia.description: Ústavní soud obdržel prezidentovu kompetenční žalobu kvůli schválené delegaci na červencový summit NATO v Ankaře, do níž vláda prezidenta nezahrnula. Soud uvedl, že si je vědom naléhavosti věci, o přednostním projednání rozhodne plénum. Prezident Petr Pavel své rozhodnutí zdůvodnil v oficiálním vyjádření, kde mimo jiné uvádí, že rozhodnutí vlády vyloučit prezidenta z delegace na summit považuje za bezprecedentní a mimořádně nešťastný krok a omezení svých ústavních pravomocí.

latvia.title: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta na summitu NATO v Ankaře
latvia.description: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta Petra Pavla na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Po jednání kabinetu to oznámil premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO). Dodal, že Česko zastoupí delegace, kterou povede předseda vlády, tedy Babiš, a doplní ji ministr zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) a ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD). Důvody rozhodnutí jsou podle Babiše čistě praktické. Kabinet probral mimo jiné výhled vývoje veřejných financí do roku 2030.

latvia.title: Petrișor Peiu, avertisment către partide și Nicușor Dan: „Dacă vor ignora opoziția, vor pierde și guvernarea viitoare”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat marți, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că „a trecut vremea politicienilor combinatori” și avertizează partidele și pe președintele Nicușor Dan „să nu mai ignore opoziția”. În caz contrar, „vor pierde și guvernarea viitoare”, susține Peiu.

latvia.title: Trump amenință din nou, cu privire la țările NATO: „Chiar am putea să o facem”
latvia.description: Preşedintele american Donald Trump a ameninţat luni ţările NATO că nu le va ajuta dacă vor cere acest lucru, justificându-şi poziţia prin faptul că acestea nu au susţinut operaţiunea sa militară împotriva Iranului.

latvia.title: Președintele ceh, interzis la summitul NATO de la Ankara: propriul guvern nu-l vrea pe Petr Pavel la Ankara
latvia.description: Guvernul ceh a anunţat luni că nu îl va include pe preşedintele Petr Pavel, fost înalt funcţionar al NATO, în delegaţia cehă de la summitul alianţei de luna viitoare de la Ankara, rupând astfel tradiţia şi declanşând o dispută juridică cu şeful statului, relatează Reuters.

latvia.title: Scurgeri de gaze la un bloc din Sectorul 3 al Capitalei: au fost evacuați 90 de oameni din cele șase scări ale imobilului
latvia.description: Circa 90 de locatari din cele şase scări ale unui bloc din Sectorul 3 al Capitalei au fost evacuaţi, luni după-amiază, după ce s-au semnalat scurgeri de gaze la o ţeavă care face legătura cu imobilul. Măsurătorile făcute în imobil nu au indicat depăşiri, astfel că locatarilor li se permite să revină în apartamente. Reprezentanţii Distrigaz Sud Reţele au precizat că au întrerupt alimentarea cu gaze în zonă, fiind afectaţi 40 de clienţi din trei scări ale blocului.

latvia.title: Alan Greenspan, cel mai influent guvernator al unei Bănci Centrale din epoca modernă, a murit la vârsta de 100 de ani
latvia.description: Economistul american Allan Greenspan, care a condus Banca Centrală a Statelor Unite timp de aproape douăzeci de ani, a decedat luni, 22 iunie, la vârsta de 100 de ani, scrie Le Monde.

latvia.title: Rusia acuză NATO și UE că pregătesc un nou plan „Barbarossa” pentru a cuceri țara lui Putin
latvia.description: NATO și Uniunea Europeană se pregătesc pentru un conflict militar cu Rusia la începutul anului 2030, iar pregătirile lor seamănă din ce în ce mai mult cu planul „Barbarossa” — strategia Germaniei naziste de a ataca URSS, a declarat adjunctul șefului Ministerului Afacerilor Externe al Federației Ruse, Alexander Grushko.

latvia.title: Peiu susține că Nicușor Dan și PSD presează AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea: „Asta ar aduce prăbuşirea partidului”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că președintele Nicușor Dan și PSD pun presiune pe AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea. Însă acest lucru „ar aduce prăbuşirea” partidului, susține acesta.

latvia.title: De ce crede Ilie Bolojan că Nicușor Dan l-a ales pe Adrian Veștea pentru a forma guvernul: „Veriga slabă”
latvia.description: Președintele PNL, Ilie Bolojan, crede că Adrian Veștea a fost desemnat premier de către șeful statului, Nicușor Dan, pentru că este „veriga slabă”. Declarația a fost făcută la Jurnalul de Seară de la Digi24.

latvia.title: Traditional Herb Market open in Rīga's Old Town
latvia.description: The traditional Herb Market opened on June 19 in Rīga’s Doma Square, offering everything needed for the colourful and tradition-rich Midsummer celebrations – Midsummer herbs, cheese, beer, and gifts. latvia.title: 'Digital television' case to be reviewed again in court
latvia.description: The Senate’s Criminal Division has reviewed the prosecutor’s appeal and overturned the Riga Regional Court’s ruling, which had found all defendants in the so-called second Digital Television criminal case not guilty and acquitted them. latvia.title: Former President Levits receives Germany's highest honour

latvia.title: Safety tips ahead of Midsummer holidays in Latvia

latvia.title: Drone-related crimes to be punished more strictly in Latvia

latvia.description: As Midsummer approaches and summer reaches its peak, urban meadows are in full bloom. lithuania.description: Pete Hegseth szerint lesznek olyan országok, amelyek elbuknak az USA felülvizsgálatán, és lesznek olyanok is, amelyek kiváló eredménnyel teljesítenek. Sokakat J. D. Vance müncheni kioktatós beszédére emlékeztetett Hegseth kirohanása a brüsszeli NATO központban.

lithuania.description: Egyetlen éjszaka, két vébémeccs.

lithuania.title: Magyar Péter szerint most jutott el a magyar nemzet odáig, ahová az 1956-osok el akarták juttatni
lithuania.description: Nagy Imrére és mártírtársaira emlékeztek az Országgyűlésben. A felemelő pillanatok után viszont jött a csörte, Orbán Balázst például a világ leggyávább magyarjának nevezte a kormányfő, és felolvasta neki az 56-os mártírok névsorát.

lithuania.title: Poland and Germany sign defence cooperation agreement
lithuania.description: The two neighbours and NATO allies will increase cooperation in military mobility, logistics infrastructure, maritime security and cybersecurity.

lithuania.title: Kryzys w relacjach polsko-ukraińskich. Apel mediów
lithuania.description: Polskie i ukraińskie media wystosowały wspólny apel wobec kryzysu, w jakim znalazły się relacje obu krajów. "To godzina próby dla Polaków i Ukraińców" - piszą autorzy. Przypominają, że Ukraina "stawia czoło zbrodniczej agresji Putina", a Polska od pierwszych godzin inwazji pomaga Kijowowi.

lithuania.title: Kryzys paliwowy w Rosji. Benzyna racjonowana po 40 litrów na samochód
lithuania.description: Seria ukraińskich ataków na rosyjską infrastrukturę wywołała poważny kryzys paliwowy w kraju, który dotarł nawet na Syberię - poinformował Reuters. Gubernator obwodu omskiego Witalij Chocenka zapowiedział na Telegramie, że sprzedaż benzyny zostanie ograniczona do 40 litrów na samochód.

lithuania.title: Petr Pavel podal na Ústavnom súde kompetenčnú žalobu proti vláde, ktorá ho vylúčila z delegácie na samite NATO
lithuania.description: Český prezident Petr Pavel podal na Ústavnom súde ČR kompetenčnú žalobu proti kroku českej vlády, ktorá rozhodla, že hlava štátu nebude členom oficiálnej delegácie na júlovom summite NATO v Turecku.

lithuania.title: Spor o účasť na samite NATO vygradoval, Pavel podal ústavnú žalobu
lithuania.description: Plénum rozhodne, či sa bude prípadom zaoberať prednostne.

lithuania.title: Kauza účasti na summite NATO graduje, Pavel sa obrátil na ústavný súd. Babiš mu pripomenul Turka
lithuania.description: Súd už avizoval, že o žalobe rozhodne čo najskôr.

lithuania.title: Ruské strategické bombardéry strávili 16 hodín vo vzduchu. Leteli aj pri hraniciach NATO
lithuania.description: Misia zahŕňala aj nácvik tankovania paliva vo vzduchu.

lithuania.title: Dron s výbušninami dopadol pri hraniciach NATO. Našiel ho muž pri kosení trávy
lithuania.description: Predpokladá sa, že toto bezpilotné lietadlo vstúpilo do vzdušného priestoru členského štátu EÚ a NATO ešte začiatkom júna.

lithuania.title: Fauly po skončení zápasu – ako pri šampionátoch narastá domáce násilie (Pod slnkom Jany Shemesh)
lithuania.description: Vážené čitateľky, vážení čitatelia, v Téme týždňa píšem o náraste domáceho násilia počas veľkých športových podujatí. Profil je venovaný indickej herečke, ktorá pravdepodobne zomrela pre veno. Prečítať si môžete aj o revolučnej japonskej starostke a o pribúdajúcom počte detských neviest v pásme Gazy. lithuania.title: Kvůli Turkovi jsem k soudu nešel, odmítl Babiš Pavlovu žalobu
lithuania.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) zveřejnil své stanovisko ke kompetenční žalobě, kterou v úterý podal prezident Petr Pavel kvůli tomu, že jej vláda neschválila jako člena delegace na červencový summit NATO v turecké Ankaře. Podle Babiše by na sebe ústavní činitelé neměli podávat žaloby a dodal, že sám na prezidenta žalobu nepodal, když Pavel odmítl jmenovat motoristického kandidáta Filipa Turka ministrem.

lithuania.title: Kdo může rozhodovat o účasti hlavy státu? Pavel chce, aby to Ústavní soud rozsekl
lithuania.description: Obsahem kompetenční žaloby, s níž se prezident Petr Pavel obrátil na Ústavní soud, je jasné určení toho, kdo může rozhodovat o účasti hlavy státu na summitu NATO. Žádá rovněž, aby kabinet prezidentovi takříkajíc „neházel klacky pod nohy“.

lithuania.title: Prezident Pavel podal k Ústavním soudu kompetenční žalobu
lithuania.description: Ústavní soud v pondělí obdržel kompetenční žalobu prezidenta. Petr Pavel ji podal v souvislosti s rozhodnutím vlády neumožnit mu účast na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Pavel považuje rozhodnutí kabinetu za bezprecedentní a nešťastné. Chce, aby ÚS vyjasnil, zda může vláda o účasti hlavy státu na summitu rozhodovat a zároveň žádá, aby ÚS uložil kabinetu nevytvářet mu překážky ve výkonu funkce prezidenta, a naopak mu poskytoval součinnost.

lithuania.title: Prezident podal kompetenční žalobu na vládu kvůli účasti na summitu NATO
lithuania.description: Ústavní soud obdržel prezidentovu kompetenční žalobu kvůli schválené delegaci na červencový summit NATO v Ankaře, do níž vláda prezidenta nezahrnula. Soud uvedl, že si je vědom naléhavosti věci, o přednostním projednání rozhodne plénum. Prezident Petr Pavel své rozhodnutí zdůvodnil v oficiálním vyjádření, kde mimo jiné uvádí, že rozhodnutí vlády vyloučit prezidenta z delegace na summit považuje za bezprecedentní a mimořádně nešťastný krok a omezení svých ústavních pravomocí.

lithuania.title: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta na summitu NATO v Ankaře
lithuania.description: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta Petra Pavla na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Po jednání kabinetu to oznámil premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO). Dodal, že Česko zastoupí delegace, kterou povede předseda vlády, tedy Babiš, a doplní ji ministr zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) a ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD). Důvody rozhodnutí jsou podle Babiše čistě praktické. Kabinet probral mimo jiné výhled vývoje veřejných financí do roku 2030.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu, avertisment către partide și Nicușor Dan: „Dacă vor ignora opoziția, vor pierde și guvernarea viitoare”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat marți, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că „a trecut vremea politicienilor combinatori” și avertizează partidele și pe președintele Nicușor Dan „să nu mai ignore opoziția”. În caz contrar, „vor pierde și guvernarea viitoare”, susține Peiu.

lithuania.title: Trump amenință din nou, cu privire la țările NATO: „Chiar am putea să o facem”
lithuania.description: Preşedintele american Donald Trump a ameninţat luni ţările NATO că nu le va ajuta dacă vor cere acest lucru, justificându-şi poziţia prin faptul că acestea nu au susţinut operaţiunea sa militară împotriva Iranului.

lithuania.title: Președintele ceh, interzis la summitul NATO de la Ankara: propriul guvern nu-l vrea pe Petr Pavel la Ankara
lithuania.description: Guvernul ceh a anunţat luni că nu îl va include pe preşedintele Petr Pavel, fost înalt funcţionar al NATO, în delegaţia cehă de la summitul alianţei de luna viitoare de la Ankara, rupând astfel tradiţia şi declanşând o dispută juridică cu şeful statului, relatează Reuters.

lithuania.title: Alan Greenspan, cel mai influent guvernator al unei Bănci Centrale din epoca modernă, a murit la vârsta de 100 de ani
lithuania.description: Economistul american Allan Greenspan, care a condus Banca Centrală a Statelor Unite timp de aproape douăzeci de ani, a decedat luni, 22 iunie, la vârsta de 100 de ani, scrie Le Monde.

lithuania.title: Rusia acuză NATO și UE că pregătesc un nou plan „Barbarossa” pentru a cuceri țara lui Putin
lithuania.description: NATO și Uniunea Europeană se pregătesc pentru un conflict militar cu Rusia la începutul anului 2030, iar pregătirile lor seamănă din ce în ce mai mult cu planul „Barbarossa” — strategia Germaniei naziste de a ataca URSS, a declarat adjunctul șefului Ministerului Afacerilor Externe al Federației Ruse, Alexander Grushko.

lithuania.title: Peiu susține că Nicușor Dan și PSD presează AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea: „Asta ar aduce prăbuşirea partidului”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că președintele Nicușor Dan și PSD pun presiune pe AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea. Însă acest lucru „ar aduce prăbuşirea” partidului, susține acesta.

lithuania.description: From June 19th to 21st, Riga will host the XX Baltic Student Song and Dance Festival “Gaudeamus”, bringing together 5,000 students from Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia.

lithuania.description: Prezidentas Gitanas Nausėda antradienį priėmė Ingos Ruginienės Vyriausybės atsistatydinimą ir pavedė jai laikinai eiti pareigas, iki kol bus paskirtas naujas Ministrų kabinetas.

lithuania.title: Iranas skelbia neleisiantis JT stebėtojams tikrinti subombarduotų branduolinių objektų
